blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Chris Hubilla missed the latter part of Jose Rizal University’s NCAA Season 102 elimination round campaign due to a leg injury. But when the Heavy Bombers needed him most to secure their return to the NCAA men’s basketball Finals, Hubilla delivered and led JRU to an 85-79 victory over Letran in Game 2 of the Final Four at Mall of Asia Arena on Thursday.
